# Every market data key form ORE's parser accepts, one key per form, taken from
# OREData/ored/marketdata/marketdatumparser.cpp (ORE v1.8.17.0; line numbers in
# each heading). Where a form branches on a token's value -- a period or a date, a
# doc clause or a running spread, a flag or none -- each branch has its own key.
# The last section holds keys ORE refuses; the catalogue records its error.
